title: Upload File Init
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /open/202512/file/init

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Use this API to initialize a file upload session. Then upload the file to the returned upload URL. Files of 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes) or less must be uploaded as a single, non-chunked request with total_chunk_count set to 1; larger files use a multipart upload. After the upload step returns a ResourceId, pass that ResourceId to the API for the target path. For more details, see https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/wfi3nz36.

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description

Get by API Get Authorization Shop

Retrieve this value by using the Get Authorized Category Assets API.
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
file_name string Y video_20251201.mp4 The name of the file to upload for this upload session.
file_type string Y video The type of file to upload. Currently, only video is supported.
file_size int Y 1024 file size, bytes
total_chunk_count int Y 1 The total number of upload chunks. Must be greater than 0. For files of 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes) or less, set this value to 1.
target_path string Y [POST]/affiliate_seller/202501/images/upload After the video is uploaded, use this interface to bind the video resource to the specific material

Request Sample

Query
